title: Structural modeling and analyses of genetic variations in the human XPC nucleotide excision repair protein.
one_liner_zh: 该文通过同源建模和AlphaFold构建人XPC蛋白结构并分析遗传变异对结构稳定性的影响，虽涉及蛋白-DNA修复蛋白的结构建模，但未聚焦TF-DNA结合互作机制，方法上以结构预测和稳定性计算为主，对TF-DNA互作建模有间接借鉴意义。
abstract: Xeroderma pigmentosum C (XPC) is a key initiator in the global genome nucleotide excision repair pathway in mammalian cells. Inherited mutations in the XPC gene can cause xeroderma pigmentosum (XP) cancer predisposition syndrome that dramatically increases the susceptibility to sunlight-induced cancers. Various genetic variants and mutations of the protein have been reported in cancer databases and literature. The current lack of a high-resolution 3-D structure of human XPC makes it difficult to assess the structural impact of the mutations/genetic variations. Using the available high-resolution crystal structure of its yeast ortholog, Rad4, we built a homology model of human XPC protein and compared it with a model generated by AlphaFold. The two models are largely consistent with each other in the structured domains. We have also assessed the degree of conservation for each residue using 966 sequences of XPC orthologs. Our structure- and sequence conservation-based assessments largely agree with the variant's impact on the protein's structural stability, computed by FoldX and SDM. Known XP missense mutations such as Y585C, W690S, and C771Y are consistently predicted to destabilize the protein's structure. Our analyses also reveal several highly conserved hydrophobic regions that are surface-exposed, which may indicate novel intermolecular interfaces that are yet to be characterized.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 着色性干皮病C（XPC）是哺乳动物细胞中全局基因组核苷酸切除修复途径的关键起始因子。XPC基因的遗传性突变可导致着色性干皮病（XP）癌症易感综合征，显著增加对阳光诱发癌症的易感性。癌症数据库和文献中已报道了该蛋白的多种遗传变异和突变。目前缺乏人XPC的高分辨率三维结构，使得评估突变/遗传变异对结构的影响变得困难。利用其酵母同源物Rad4的现有高分辨率晶体结构，我们构建了人XPC蛋白的同源模型，并将其与AlphaFold生成的模型进行了比较。两个模型在结构域上大体一致。我们还利用966条XPC同源物序列评估了每个残基的保守程度。我们基于结构和序列保守性的评估与通过FoldX和SDM计算的变异对蛋白质结构稳定性的影响基本一致。已知的XP错义突变如Y585C、W690S和C771Y均被一致预测为会破坏蛋白质结构的稳定性。我们的分析还揭示了几个高度保守且表面暴露的疏水区域，这可能表明存在尚未表征的新型分子间界面。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
